tools.name: agentgas_quote
tools.description: Free price quote: how much USDC (on Base, paid via gasless x402) buys a given amount of native gas (ETH on base/arbitrum/optimism, POL on polygon). Returns price_usdc, breakdown and the exact x402 URL to pay. Rejects bad input or over-capacity before any payment.

tools.name: agentgas_status
tools.description: Live per-chain float, availability, prices and daily caps of the AgentGas service. Check before paying.

tools.name: agentgas_order
tools.description: Status of an AgentGas order by order_id: pending, processing, delivered (with payout_tx on the destination chain) or refunded (with refund_tx on Base).

tools.name: agentgas_how_to_buy
tools.description: Step-by-step instructions plus the exact x402 payment URL for buying native gas for an address. This MCP server cannot sign payments; your x402 client (e.g. @x402/fetch) pays the URL with USDC on Base, gasless (EIP-3009 signature, no ETH needed).
